notes.title: Oryks Technical Update v1.2
notes.content:
Oryks Technical Update v1.2

Fixed a bug that would hang the game on some devices.

Optimized the game to be even smoother

Reduced the size of the game.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Added:[/b]

-Steam achievements

-Technical optimizations

-Almanac about the game's monsters

notes.title: Important update coming in December!
notes.content:
[b]Important update coming in December![/b]

The update will include:

-Improved optimization so that the game will run smoother and run on weaker devices than before 

-Adding steam achievements!

-Additional story content 

-Almanac with descriptions to improve understanding of the game world

Update: December 1, 2024
